about: Curated stops for the Appalachia and Mid-South legs (missing roads pass, 2026-11-23), placed by cargo tools osm-stops --stops. Started from the stops the region's existing legs carry with a position and a source, so a stop on a shared road lands on a new leg too; heading for those was derived from the side the old leg placed them on (the leg's own direction of travel at the stop). Stops for the new legs, the re-routed legs and the long legs with no usable stop were added from the OpenStreetMap planet file of 2026-11-16: named truck stops and service areas, rest areas, truck parking, and town fuel stations where a stretch of more than 45 miles had nothing else. lat, lon, reach_mi, season and heading steer placement; every other key is the stop as the game reads it.

truck_access.about: Stops added in this pass whose tractor-trailer access was read from OpenStreetMap's hgv tag, and those where it is assumed with the reason in source: rest areas and truck stops with no hgv tag, and town diesel stations, which are marked bobtail only. The stops carried over from the region's existing legs keep their own sources.
